mentions.name: SlashLink
mentions.description: A simple pay-as-you-go Amazon link localizer aimed at affiliate marketers, positioned as a cheaper alternative to Genius, built on Cloudflare Workers with SQLite (D1).
mentions.problem: Existing Amazon link localization tools like Genius are more expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt: SlashLink(https://slashlink.app) $0 - A simple pay as you go amazon link localizer. Great for affiliate folks and a cheaper alternative to Genius. Stack is same, CF workers with SQLite(D1)
